verdict.rationale: TaxJar stores transactions pushed via the API (createOrder, transaction upload), accepts a product_tax_code on each line item, offers address validation, and its pricing page lists an "Archive of historical sales tax data". Together these suggest some per-transaction record is retained, but nothing shows it captures the applied rate, rules, or address resolution behind each calculation, or that it can be exported for an audit. Missing for 10: documented per-transaction calculation breakdown (rate, jurisdiction rules, resolved address, category applied), retention guarantees, audit export, independent or hands-on corroboration.
